build_gemma4_model: build a Gemma4 language model for vLLM with VllmConfig, supporting MoE, LoRA, and pipeline parallelism
create_gemma4_attention: create a Gemma4Attention module with QKV projection, RMSNorm, RoPE, and sliding window attention
run_gemma4_forward: run a Gemma4Model forward pass with input_ids, positions, and optional per_layer_inputs for PLE
test_gemma4_routing: test the Gemma4MoE routing function that computes top-k expert selection with per-expert scaling
refactor_gemma4_weights: refactor Gemma4ForCausalLM weight loading to support k_eq_v layers and 3D packed MoE expert weights
